plainText:
(Japanese: 数尾学 Manabu Kazuo) is a character from Pokémon Battrio: Aim to be Battrio Master!.

==History==
Manabu first appeared in ABM02 where he saw Ryū and the others with a Battrio machine Dr. Yoshimura brought out. After bragging about his stuff, Manabu challenged Ryū to a match. Despite trying his best and using a team stronger than Ryū's, Manabu was defeated in the end and appeared to respect Ryū as a strong Battrio player.

==Pokémon==
